detailed_results.explanation: Regulation R12_CONTRACT_END_REQUIRES_AWARD requires that if a contract ends (is terminated/ended), an award must have existed before that contract end; a contract end without an award is prohibited. In the provided complete case log for case_id EVAL0041, there is a CONTRACT-END event dated 2026-08-20, but there is no AWARD event at any time in the case timeline (award_count = 0; events present are only PUBLICATION and CONTRACT-END). Because the logs are sufficient to determine that a contract end occurred and that no award occurred beforehand (or at all), the case conflicts with the regulation and is therefore non-compliant.
